headline: TCS signs $2 billion AI partnership with Microsoft
text: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced a $2 billion strategic partnership with Microsoft to accelerate generative AI adoption across enterprise clients. The deal will see TCS build AI-powered solutions on Microsoft Azure, with analysts calling the tie-up a major win for the IT services giant.

headline: TCS expands generative AI services division
text: TCS said it will expand its generative AI services division after strong client demand, hiring over 5000 engineers focused on AI and cloud technology in the coming year.

headline: TCS reports strong quarterly earnings
text: TCS reported quarterly revenue growth of 12% year over year, beating analyst estimates. Net profit rose 15%, driven by strong demand in its BFSI and technology segments.

headline: TCS quarterly profit beats estimates
text: TCS posted a quarterly profit that beat Wall Street and Dalal Street estimates alike, with margins expanding on the back of cost discipline and higher-value AI contracts.

headline: TCS hiring guidance remains cautious
text: Despite strong earnings, TCS management flagged cautious hiring guidance for the next two quarters, citing macroeconomic uncertainty in key markets.

headline: Reliance announces major energy expansion
text: Reliance Industries announced a significant expansion of its renewable energy business, with a new $10 billion investment in solar manufacturing capacity over the next five years.

headline: Reliance retail arm posts record festive season sales
text: Reliance Retail reported record festive season sales, with same-store sales growth of 18%, driven by strong demand across its grocery and fashion formats.

headline: Reliance faces regulatory scrutiny over telecom pricing
text: Indian regulators opened a review into Reliance Jio's telecom pricing practices following complaints from smaller competitors about predatory pricing.

headline: Infosys wins large cloud modernization contract
text: Infosys announced it has won a multi-year cloud modernization contract worth $500 million from a European bank, strengthening its position in financial services technology.

headline: Infosys reports steady quarterly performance
text: Infosys reported quarterly results broadly in line with analyst expectations, with revenue growth of 6% and stable margins despite a challenging demand environment.

headline: Infosys announces leadership change in Americas unit
text: Infosys announced a leadership change in its Americas business unit, appointing a new regional head effective next quarter as part of a broader restructuring.

headline: HDFC Bank flags rising loan defaults
text: HDFC Bank flagged a rise in loan defaults in its unsecured retail lending book, prompting analysts to raise questions about asset quality risks heading into the next fiscal year.

headline: HDFC Bank reports robust deposit growth
text: HDFC Bank reported robust deposit growth of 14% year over year, helping offset margin pressure from rising funding costs.

headline: HDFC Bank completes merger integration milestone
text: HDFC Bank said it has completed a key milestone in its merger integration with HDFC Ltd, consolidating loan books and branch operations ahead of schedule.

headline: Investors debate AI spending sustainability
text: Investors and analysts are increasingly debating whether current levels of enterprise AI spending are sustainable, with some warning of a potential slowdown in 2027 if returns on AI investment disappoint.
